Class EndRoundEvent

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.Event
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.UpdateEvent
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.messages.events.EndRoundEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class EndRoundEvent extends UpdateEvent
Event representing the end of a round during the game. Inherits from UpdateEvent. It contains the updated state of the board, the updated attributes for all players, and the current age of the game.

    • EndRoundEvent

      public EndRoundEvent(Board board, List<Player> players, int gameId, int currentAge)
      Constructs an EndRoundEvent triggered by the server model at the end of a round.
      Parameters:
      board - the current Board state at the end of the round.
      players - the list of Player objects participating in the game.
      gameId - the unique ID of the game this event belongs to.
      currentAge - the updated current age of the game.

    • EndRoundEvent

      public EndRoundEvent(ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> board, Map<String, ArrayList<Integer>> playersAttributes, String description, int currentAge)
      Constructs an EndRoundEvent from JSON data, used by Jackson upon receiving a message.
      Parameters:
      board - the state of the board represented by lists of card IDs.
      playersAttributes - a map associating each player's nickname with a list of their attributes (food and prestige points).
      description - the description of the event.
      currentAge - the current age of the game.
